sentence: The firm-value effect of AI human capital is strongest in travel, while the inequality compression concentrates in hospitality
passage: [Agag et al. (2026), p. 1] "Sectoral analyses reveal stronger value associations in travel and stronger inequality compression associations in hospitality."

gemini.note: The passage describes correlational 'associations' that are 'stronger' in certain sectors, which the sentence overstates as a causal 'effect' that is the 'strongest' and 'concentrates' there.
